Load Cart from LocalStorage useEffect(() => { // Check if we have saved shipping info from a previous attempt const savedShipping = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('shipping_info')); if (savedShipping) { setShippingInfo(savedShipping); } }, []); // 2. Pre-fill User Data useEffect(() => { if (user) { setShippingInfo(prev => ({ ...prev, email: user.email || '', firstName: user.displayName ? user.displayName.split(' ')[0] : '', lastName: user.displayName ? user.displayName.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ') : '' })); } }, [user]); // Handle Input Change const handleChange = (e) => { const { name, value } = e.target; setShippingInfo(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value })); }; // Handle Submit const handleSubmit = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); // Save shipping info to localStorage (optional, for persistence across reloads) localStorage.setItem('shipping_info', JSON.stringify(shippingInfo)); // Navigate to Payment Step with Data navigate('/checkout/payment', { state: { shippingInfo, cartItems, totals } }); }; return (
